Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.password

Class UserAccountUserDetailsService

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.password.UserAccountUserDetailsService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsPasswordService, org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService
@Component public class UserAccountUserDetailsService extends Object implements org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService, org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsPasswordService
Spring Security UserDetailsService adapter over the FindUserAccountUseCase use case: it maps the domain UserAccount onto Spring Security's UserDetails through the UserDetailsMapper. As a UserDetailsPasswordService it also stores the stronger hash that the authentication provider produces after a successful sign-in with an outdated encoding, through the UpgradePasswordHashUseCase use case.
